subject: Changing the testing instances file after training has completed

messages.author: d99d7bfa6a6b94c5
messages.subject: Changing the testing instances file after training has completed
parts:
The training phase of irace has been completed and I went on to test the configurations using:

testing.main(logFile = "./irace-1000.Rdata")

However, I had a bug in my testing instances file and it therefore failed to run. I have fixed the bug but irace is still getting stuck at the bug and I believe it is because Irace is working from the old testing instances file. Is there a way to change this file and run testing without having to re run from the beginning and train again?

Thank you in advance for any help!

messages.author: 854a0709976c2a48
messages.subject: Re: Changing the testing instances file after training has completed
parts:
If you load the file "./irace-1000.Rdata" and look at iraceResults$scenario$testInstances you can view or modify the test instances (or almost anything else). You can re-save the file with save(iraceResults, file = "./irace-1000.Rdata")

I hope this helps!

Manuel.
